desc: These algae may look inconspicuous, but they are highly versatile.
obtain: Algae is obtained from Algae plants found underwater in the Veilwater Basin biome. Algae can also be grown from Algae Seedlings.

desc: These are the buds of an algae plant. They're inedible when raw, but can be dried.
An algae salad that tastes fresh and vaguely salty, like the sea. Something so green and natural must be healthy.
ingredients_zh: 藻类 x5、生姜 x4、糖 x3、香菇 x5

desc: An antidote that instantly cures any poison effect.
ingredients_zh: 毒囊 x1、牛奶 x3、蜘蛛腺体 x5

desc: A beautiful yellow flower with magical properties that increases the user's mana.
obtain: Aureolin Flower is obtained from Aureolin Flowers, found in the Springlands biome. Aureolin Flowers can also be grown from Aureolin Flower Seedlings. fr:Fleur d'auréoline

desc: The Azure Russula — an ancient mushroom, existing and consuming magic since the beginning of time. Unfortunately inedible if not cooked.
obtain: is obtained from Azure Russula mushrooms, first found in the Revelwood biome. They are often found in caves. Azure Russulas can also be grown from Azure Russula Seedlings.

desc: A ripe, yellow banana. It can be eaten raw or used in another dish — without the peel, of course.
This item heals 40% health over 10 seconds if applied to a wound. Receiving any damage interrupts the healing effect.
A burning hot, meaty stew. Increases your resistance against extreme cold and improves your health and health regeneration.
ingredients_zh: 鸡蛋 x2、生肥肉 x3、番茄 x4、卷毛山羊奶 x3

desc: A crisp, vibrant red bell pepper with a sweet, juicy flavor and a glossy skin.
obtain: is obtained from Bell Pepper plants, found in the Nomad Highlands biome. Bell Peppers can also be grown from Bell Pepper Seedlings. fr:Poivron

desc: A freshly brewed cup of coffee. The flavor is strong, bold, and lightly acidic. What better way to start the day?
ingredients_zh: 水 x5、研磨咖啡豆 x5、金币 x5

desc: Simple but nourishing. Boosts regeneration in all areas.
Creamy butter with milky richness-perfect for bringing depth and tenderness to your baked creations.
A refreshing jug of buttermilk. With its lightly sour flavor and silky texture, it’s very refreshing.
A soup made from various vegetables and calla luna flowers. It glows in the dark and extends your time in the Shroud!
ingredients_zh: 水 x5、盐 x1、月光马蹄莲 x3、鼠尾草叶 x5

desc: Peppery, sweet, and packing a punch - this candied ginger is a great snack for anyone not afraid of strong flavours.
A very healthy beverage that helps the body recover and prepare for the day to come.
It tastes incredibly bitter when raw, but develops a zesty aroma while cooked.
obtain: The item was added as part of the Souls of the Frozen Frontier update so the shroud areas in Albaneve Summits contain this item. Specifically, many Chanterelle can be found close to the Watchtower point of interest in the shroud directly north of the Nomad Heights spire. Note, These are rather small and can be missed with ease if your not looking down towards the ground. Note, for easier farming of this item there are several patches of this mushroom just south west of the Ancient Spire Albaneve Summits, See picture for details thumb thumb

desc: A very healthy soup made by boiling chicken for a period of time. An old house maiden's dish to help protect the body from illness
ingredients_zh: 水 x5、森林甜菜 x3、盐 x1、生禽肉 x3、甜椒 x3

desc: Restores 60% of health over 10 seconds. Stops when damage is received.
ingredients_zh: 细线 x1、抗菌剂 x1、破布 x1
obtain: They can be crafted or found as a drop.

desc: A cold smoothie made from coconuts and bananas. Best served with a little decorative umbrella, a cozy spot on the beach, and two swirly straws.
This creamy coconut milk makes for a great refreshment on a sunny day by the shore! It can also be used as an ingredient in cooking.
A delicious jug of Fae Deer milk. Drinking it will grant you endurance and recharge your stamina faster!
ingredients_zh: 蜂蜜 x1、未煮妖精鹿奶 x4

desc: This cooked rice is delicious and vaguely aromatic. It will make for a good side dish.
A very versatile crop that can be dried, grilled or consumed raw, strengthening the consumer for a short duration.
obtain: is obtained from Corn plants, found in the Springlands biome. Each Corn plant gives you x3 corncobs. Corncobs can also be grown from Corn Seedlings. fr:Épi de maïs

desc: A delicacy of the marine world, it is crispy on the outside and soft and full of flavor on the inside. It is the perfect meal for weary adventurers.
ingredients_zh: 蟹肉 x5、鸡蛋 x3、盐 x5、牛奶 x2

desc: You should only eat crab meat when it is grilled, as this is the best way to prepare it.
obtain: is dropped by Crabs and Drak.

desc: A local delicacy with a creamy texture and rich taste. It fills the belly and heals the soul, especially when the north winds are howling outside.
ingredients_zh: 面粉 x2、鸡蛋 x5、卷毛山羊奶 x3、美味牛肝菌 x5

desc: The Crimsonback, once a common Silverback that survived countless migrations, has scales that burn with a deep red hue. It is said to embody strength and endurance, and it is prized by seasoned anglers for its power and beauty. It can be eaten raw, but will be even more beneficial when processed further.
obtain: Crimsonback can be obtained while fishing using Rare Baits like , and .

desc: A flask brewed from rare underwater materials, easing the strain of every powerful stroke.
ingredients_zh: 藻类 x10、藻芽 x10、珍珠母 x10、珍珠 x1

desc: A dark concoction distilled from enemy remains. It unveils the writings of their kin and sharpens your blade against them.
ingredients_zh: 德拉克鳞片 x10、德拉克牙齿 x10、德拉克之爪 x10、德拉克之血 x10

desc: These conserved banana chips do not regenerate as much health as the raw fruit. However, the duration of their effect lasts longer - and the crunch is nice too.
When conserved, the Dried Purple Berry do not regenerate as much Health as the Purple berries. However, the duration lasts longer.
obtain: is crafted by the Drying Rack. The crafting recipe requires obtaining to unlock. It can also be picked up as a physical item in the world.

desc: Unnerving goo. It bestows great powers on those who eat it.
obtain: Ectoplasm Soup is crafted by the Collector

desc: A great source of protein that enhances the muscle mass. Best consumed before a good exercise.
obtain: Eggs are dropped by several creatures, primarily the Flightless Redtail, starting in the Nomad Highlands. They are also collected from domesticated Flightless Redtail.

desc: This Elixir of the Shroud contains great power.... at a cost.
obtain: The (known as Mysterious Flask) can be picked up as a physical item in Scavenger camps or as a random drop from Scavengers.

desc: This striking red fish is marked with black stripes. Its shimmering scales resemble cooling embers, earning it the name "Emberfin".
obtain: can be obtained while fishing using Rare Baits like , and .

desc: Even the most carefully cooked Ectoplasm Soup still tastes a little bit...fermented.
ingredients_zh: 丝兰果 x5、优质灵质 x5
obtain: Excellent Ectoplasm Soup is crafted by the Collector

desc: The most different experiences gathered and described on a scroll. Gain a small amount of experience based upon absorption of the content.
Removes Fell Curse upon use. Also applies a buff that prevents the curse from affecting the user for an hour.
ingredients_zh: 水 x1、新鲜迷雾孢子 x2

desc: The scroll summons a Fire Wisp that follows, assists you in battle and provides light.
A hearty, creamy soup made with tender chunks of fish and fresh vegetables.
ingredients_zh: 玉米芯 x3、任意稀有鱼 x3、森林甜菜 x5、牛奶 x5、面粉 x2

desc: Fish cut into thick slices, be aware of the the bones, but you can still enjoy it.
ingredients_zh: 任意稀有鱼 x1、金币 x1

desc: The Filet of an epic fish, don't worry about any fish bones, they have been thoroughly removed.
ingredients_zh: 任意史诗鱼 x1、金币 x1

desc: The Shroud grants power to not only the Fell, but to whoever drinks from this flask.
ingredients_zh: 活性菌丝 x10、草莓 x1、雾瘴蘑菇 x10
obtain: The recipe is unlocked by obtaining a as part of . It is then crafted by the Alchemist.

desc: A simple meal, granting a lasting Melee Damage boost upon consumption. It tastes better in combination with other things, though.
ingredients_zh: 水 x5、盐 x2、面粉 x3

desc: If pure, cooked rice is a bit too plain for you, then this fried rice might satisfy your needs. The added egg breaks up the granular texture of the rice, and the vegetables create a punch of flavor!
ingredients_zh: 煮米饭 x5、鸡蛋 x5、甜椒 x3、玉米芯 x3、生芋头 x2

desc: A delicious jug of Frizzy Goat milk. Drinking it will grant you endurance.
A refreshing bowl of fruits with positive health benefits.
ingredients_zh: 蜂蜜 x5、草莓 x4、紫色浆果 x4、丝兰果 x5、阴郁浆果 x4

desc: Fresh ginger, perfect for brewing hot tea to keep any cold at bay.
This ginger tea tastes like the paragon of good health.
This is an herbal tea with added glimmer gentian. The Blossoms create a smooth texture and extend your Time in the shroud.
ingredients_zh: 水 x3、微光龙胆 x3、萝藦星花 x3

desc: A special berry that can only be harvested at night in the Revelwood. It can be used to enhance various dishes and to create deep blue pigments.
obtain: Gloomberry is harvested from plants in the Revelwood at night. The plant grows a bright blue and is easily seen from afar.

desc: A weird brew emitting a blue glow...Nobody quite knows why.
ingredients_zh: 水 x5、香料 x4、蓝红菇 x10
obtain: The recipe is unlocked after crafting spice in the laboratory after obtaining the almanac of Plants and Seedlings.

desc: A resilient herb, growing in the harsh Kindlewastes climate. Spiritualists were known to use it for mystical purposes.
obtain: is obtained from Grapple Plants, found in the Kindlewastes biome. Large amounts can be found at Rose Shell Burrow and Sunsimmer Souterrain. Grapple Plant can also be grown from Grapple Plant Seedlings.

desc: An improved antidote that will cure poison and negate the next poisoning.
ingredients_zh: 毒囊 x1、雾霭蒸汽 x3、狼毒乌头 x1、煤粉 x1

desc: This slimy soup was improved with some salt, slow-cooked broth, and the added aroma of fearing death.
obtain: Greater Ectoplasm Soup is crafted by the Collector

desc: After finetuning the Health Potion, the ingredients were adjusted, instantly restoring a great amount of health upon consumption.
ingredients_zh: 蜂蜜 x1、水 x1、紫色浆果 x1、洋甘菊 x1
obtain: The recipe is unlocked by obtaining a as part of . It is then crafted by the Alchemist.

desc: Instantly restores a medium amount of health, and continuosly heals for 10 seconds.
ingredients_zh: 强效生命药水 x1、阴郁浆果 x1

desc: A mana potion with higher concentration, instantly restoring a great amount of mana upon use.
ingredients_zh: 蓝红菇 x4、炼金基底 x1

desc: Instantly restores a medium amount of mana, and continuously replenishes it for 10 seconds.
ingredients_zh: 月光马蹄莲 x1、强效法力药水 x1

desc: Contains cleansed Shroud Liquid, enhancing the resistance of the user. Extends the Maximum time in the shroud after consumption by 4 Minutes. This effect will last for 45 Minutes.
ingredients_zh: 炼金基底 x1、薄荷蘑菇肉 x15、小动物腺体 x1

desc: These grilled algae buds can be sprinkled on your food to maximize flavor. They have added health benefits, too!
A healthy protein rich snack. The color looks just perfect..
A generous portion of grilled meat. It must've come from a giant crab. Enjoy!
Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.
Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.
Beautifully tender, juicy meat. It fills the belly and warms the soul by providing better frost resistance!
The light sweetness of the coconut rice pairs well with the smoky fish filet. A shame you couldn't add a hint of lime or lemon!
ingredients_zh: 香煎鱼片 x5、椰奶 x5、煮米饭 x5、烤藻芽 x5、生芋头 x2

desc: A staple in many traditional Revelwood dishes. It has a rejuvenating effect.
Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.
Rich in protein and delicious, but only a small snack. Increases the Constitution of the user by a small margin.

Roasted ribs were a delicacy back in the day, granting a good amount of Constitution to the consumer.
obtain: Obtained from by manually cooking it at a fireplace, or by using a Cooking Station.

desc: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.
When cooked, the Yucca Fruit becomes very sweet. Makes the mouth water and recovers Stamina.
A nice snack for the way. The strength it takes to crack its shell, it gives back upon consumption.
obtain: is harvested from Hazelnut bushes, found in the Revelwood biome. Each bush yields multiple hazelnuts. Hazelnut bushes can also be grown from Hazelnut Bush Seedlings.

desc: Filled with vitalizing ingredients, it instantly restores a good amount of health.
ingredients_zh: 水 x1、美味牛肝菌 x1、紫色浆果 x1
obtain: is crafted by the Alchemist. The crafting recipe requires obtaining to unlock. It can also be picked up as a physical item in the world or looted from chests.

desc: Instantly restores a small amount of health, and continuously heals for 10 seconds.
ingredients_zh: 生命药水 x1、午夜百合 x1
obtain: is crafted by the Alchemist. The crafting recipe requires obtaining to unlock.
